return segmentNames.some((segment) => user.segments.some((own) => own.includes(segment)))

This uses substring matching (`own.includes(segment)`), but the spec requires exact full-string equality. Fix:

```js
return segmentNames.some((segment) => user.segments.some((own) => own === segment))
```
